caption_L1: This bar graph is named Number of stolen or lost firearms in the U.S. in 2019 , by state. There is a linear scale from 0 to 1,400 along the y-axis, labeled Number of firearms stolen or lost. On the x-axis, State is measured with a categorical scale from Alabama to Wyoming.
caption_L2L3: The majority of states had 400 or less firearms lost or stolen in 2019.  Only 7 states out of 50 had over this number.  Of these 7 states, 5 had between 400 and 600 firearms lost or stolen, with the remaining 2 (Florida and Texas) having 1400 and just over 1000 firearms respectively lost or stolen.    There were 4 states that had extremely low figures - Delaware, Hawaii, New Jersey and Rhode Island.
